fn power(base: Int, exp: Int) -> Int
  requires (exp >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if (exp == 0) then 1 else (base * power(base, (exp - 1)))))
  ensures ((not (base >= 0)) or (result >= 0))
  ensures ((not (base > 0)) or (result > 0))
  effects pure
  example (power(0, 0) == 1)
  example (power(0, 1) == 0)
{
  if (exp == 0) then 1 else (base * power(base, (exp - 1)))
}

fn CountStartsWith1(n: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 1)
  ensures (result == power(10, (n - 1)))
  ensures (result == power(10, (n - 1)))
  effects pure
  example (CountStartsWith1(1) == 1)
  example (CountStartsWith1(2) == 10)
{
  power(10, (n - 1))
}

fn CountEndsWith1(n: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 1)
  ensures (result == (if (n == 1) then 1 else (9 * power(10, (n - 2)))))
  ensures ((not (n == 1)) or (result == 1))
  ensures ((not (n >= 2)) or (result == (9 * power(10, (n - 2)))))
  effects pure
  example (CountEndsWith1(1) == 1)
  example (CountEndsWith1(2) == 9)
{
  if (n == 1) then 1 else (9 * power(10, (n - 2)))
}

fn CountStartsAndEndsWith1(n: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 1)
  ensures (result == (if (n <= 2) then 1 else power(10, (n - 2))))
  ensures ((not (n == 1)) or (result == 1))
  ensures ((not (n == 2)) or (result == 1))
  ensures ((not (n >= 3)) or (result == power(10, (n - 2))))
  effects pure
  example (CountStartsAndEndsWith1(1) == 1)
  example (CountStartsAndEndsWith1(3) == 10)
{
  if (n <= 2) then 1 else power(10, (n - 2))
}

fn starts_one_ends(n: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 1)
  ensures (result == ((CountStartsWith1(n) + CountEndsWith1(n)) - CountStartsAndEndsWith1(n)))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (starts_one_ends(0) == 0)
{
  0
}
